description:
Returns the catalogue of all supported weather metric identifiers with units and categories.
When to use: Resolve metric IDs to human-friendly names, units, and categories. Call once and cache per session.
Performance: Fast — static data; safe to cache for the lifetime of a session.
Prerequisites: None.
Investigate: Call once at session start; use metric.id as a lookup key throughout the conversation.
Augment: Translate metric IDs into readable labels for article text and chart axes. Returns: metrics, metric.id, metric.name, metric.cat, metric.type, metric.dist.
name: metrics
title: List Metrics
